_comment: Canonical route-level performance budgets. Enforced category by category by scripts/route-weight-budget.mjs (called from scripts/perf-gate.sh) and cross-checked by Lighthouse total-byte-weight in lighthouserc.json. Lab budgets are set against a deliberate low-end stress profile, not a median connection. INP is a field metric: inp_ms is enforced from RUM/CrUX at p75 (observability), never from Lighthouse navigation runs. See deploy/references/performance-gate.md and deploy/references/africa-calibration.md.

global._comment_metrics: lcp_ms and cls apply to lab and field (field at p75 per device class); inp_ms applies to field/RUM only; tbt_ms is the lab interactivity proxy. Core Web Vitals 'good' thresholds per web.dev (checked 2026-09-23): LCP 2500 ms, INP 200 ms, CLS 0.1 at p75. The engine's lab LCP 2000 ms is stricter by design.
global._comment_total: total_weight_kb is the binding first-load cap per route: html + css + js (gzip) + fonts + all eager images. The per-category caps below are separate ceilings and sum to more than the total by design. Templates such as /blog/[slug]/ are gated through one representative built page each.

/contact/._comment: Forms add modest JS; budget relaxed 10KB not 40KB. No third-party form widgets.

/blog/[slug]/._comment: Longer copy and a hero image; held to the global total. Raising it needs an exception_decision entry.

network_profile.name: low-end-stress-wpt-3g
network_profile.label: Low-end stress profile: WebPageTest '3G' preset network values with 4x CPU slowdown
network_profile.device_emulation: Lighthouse mobile emulation (moto g power 2022, 412x823, DPR 1.75)
network_profile._comment: Deliberate worst-case floor, not a market median. Lighthouse's own default mobile throttling is 1.6 Mbps / 150 ms RTT / 4x CPU. Measured field reality is much faster in some markets (Ookla Speedtest Global Index, Kenya median mobile about 45 Mbps down / 28 ms, quarter to June 2026; Uganda mobile median not published). Sources: docs/source-registers/performance-currentness-2026-09-23.json. Label lab evidence separately from field evidence.

fail_policy._comment: No tolerance on primary metrics. A 5% warn allows local cache noise without failing CI.

lighthouse_default_mobile.use: advisory comparison with PageSpeed Insights lab data

field.source: CrUX or first-party RUM at p75 per device class
field.use: INP enforcement and lab-to-field calibration; see deploy/references/lab-to-field-calibration.md
